blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Protest movements calling for Vice President Sara Duterte’s conviction before the Senate Impeachment Court have started to swell as the prosecution team looks to wrap up the presentation of witnesses and documentary evidence. Akbayan Party-list, one of the groups that organized the rally outside the Senate premises along Jose W. Diokno Boulevard in Pasay City, said on Monday that their organization had around 2,500 protesters. Another 10,000 participants from other civil society groups joined the rally, bringing the total to 12,500. The Filipino novelty folk song “Gloria Gloria Labandera” also appears to have returned to the political scene, as protesters […]...
